scope: Validate ARM64 schema replay CPU budgets before disposable Docker resources are created.

behavior.invalid_input: A positive CPU value that rounds to zero nanocpus is rejected by argument preflight.
behavior.side_effect_order: resource_limit_values runs before disposable-project inspection, image inspection, and container creation.

checks.diagnostic: CPU limit must round to at least one nanocpu

limitations: This proves parser-level resource validation only; it does not add ARM64 execution, physical Raspberry Pi, or production recovery evidence.
